name: banner

states.name: closable
states.what: a dismiss × is shown; clicking it hides the banner and emits close

summary: An inline notice / callout — a tinted surface with a status icon and a message. Intents: info (default, NEUTRAL), note (blue), success, warning, error. Persistent and in-flow — not a transient toast, not a blocking modal.
selectHint: Use for a persistent inline message tied to a section (a form hint, a visibility notice, a non-blocking warning). For a transient auto-dismiss message use a toast; for a blocking decision use obs-modal.

variants.name: info
variants.what: default — NEUTRAL subtle notice: --neutral-lightest surface (#ecf1f9) + --neutral-regular text & icon (#7186a8), near-borderless. e.g. 'Anyone in the organization can view this dashboard.'

variants.name: note
variants.what: a BLUE callout: --info-surface blue bg (#eef5fc) + --info-text blue icon (#2f6099), dark text — an emphasised informational highlight

variant.note: the intent → surface/border/icon+text colour. info (default) is the subtle periwinkle notice; note is the emphasised brand-blue callout.

title.note: optional bold heading above the message

icon.note: override the default per-variant icon (a library key)

closable.note: show a dismiss × (emits close, then hides itself via [hidden])

decisionFlow: A persistent message tied to a section / form (a hint, a visibility notice)? -> obs-banner (variant by intent).
A transient, auto-dismissing message after an action (saved/deleted)? -> a toast, NOT obs-banner.
A blocking decision the user must answer? -> obs-modal (confirm), NOT obs-banner.
Just a destructive-action warning inside a form? -> obs-banner variant="error" (inline), not a modal.

info.useWhen: the DEFAULT low-key notice — neutral surface + muted grey-blue text (--neutral-lightest / --neutral-regular).
info.dontUse: when you need emphasis — use note; for success/failure use success/error
info.example: 'Anyone in the organization can view this dashboard. Edit access is limited to you and Dashboard Admins.'

success.useWhen: a positive inline confirmation that should persist on the surface
success.dontUse: for transient post-save feedback — that's a toast
success.example: 'Sharing updated — 3 users can now view this.'

warning.useWhen: a non-blocking caution the user should read before acting
warning.dontUse: for a hard block — use obs-modal

error.useWhen: an inline error/destructive notice kept in context
error.dontUse: for a blocking decision — use obs-modal (confirm)
error.example: 'At least one user is required when Private.'

closable.useWhen: the notice is dismissible and not essential to keep on screen
closable.dontUse: for a notice that must stay (a permanent form hint)
closable.example: closable → user can dismiss a one-time tip

note.useWhen: an emphasised BLUE callout (blue bg + blue icon) that should stand out more than the neutral info.
note.dontUse: for a routine notice (use info) or for status feedback (success/warning/error)
note.example: a highlighted 'note' or tip that needs more attention than the default info

do: Use obs-banner for a persistent inline notice; pick the variant by intent (info default).
Keep the message short; put a lead-in in `title` and the detail in the slot.
Let the colours come from the tokens (info-* / severity-*) — never hardcode.
dont: Don't use a banner for transient post-action feedback (that's a toast) or for a blocking choice (that's obs-modal).
Don't reuse an off-purpose token for the surface — obs-banner uses --info-surface (info) / --primary-alt-lighter (note) / severity surfaces.
Don't stack many banners; one notice per surface.

a11y.summary: The banner is a role=status live region so assistive tech announces it; the icon is decorative (aria-hidden) and the dismiss button has an aria-label.

changelog: 2026-08-10 — Colours (owner, minimal): info (default) → NEUTRAL — --neutral-lightest surface + --neutral-regular text & icon (token-based, no hex). note → BLUE — --info-surface bg + --info-text blue icon. (--info-* tokens reverted to their blue values.)

2026-08-10 — Variant rework (owner, ref image #149): the `info` variant (still the DEFAULT) is now the product SUBTLE notice — soft periwinkle surface + muted blue-grey TEXT (the message text itself, not just the icon), near-borderless — matching the real 'Anyone in the organization can view this dashboard' banner. Repointed the --info-surface/--info-text/--info-border tokens to those subtle values. The previous saturated-blue info moved to a NEW `note` variant (emphasised brand-blue callout). Banner text now follows --bn-text per variant.

2026-08-07 — Added obs-banner (Tier 2, gap G2): an inline notice/callout with info/success/warning/error intents, using the new --info-surface/--info-border/--info-text tokens (previously there was no inline-banner component and no info-surface token, so consumers reused --neutral-lightest off-purpose).
